title: Vanishing of Cech H^1 on a cofinal system of coverings gives surjectivity on sections (any site)
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $0\to\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\iota}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{\varphi}\mathcal H\to0$ a short exact sequence in the abelian category $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $U$ be an object of $\mathcal C$ and suppose there is a set $\Sigma$ of coverings of $U$ which is cofinal (every covering $\{V_j\to U\}_{j\in J}$ of $U$ is refined by some $\{U_t\to U\}_{t\in T}\in\Sigma$: for every $t$ there are $j\in J$ and a morphism $U_t\to V_j$ over $U$) and such that $\check H^1(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)=0$ for every $\mathcal U\in\Sigma$ (Cech cohomology [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]). Then $\varphi_U:\mathcal G(U)\to\mathcal H(U)$ is surjective. (General-site version of [lem-weil-pbc-ses-cech-h1-surjective], which is stated for the small etale site and whose proof applies verbatim once 'epimorphism of abelian sheaves = locally surjective' and 'kernels are sectionwise' are available on a general site.)

source.place: Lemma Tag 03F8 (lemma-ses-cech-h1) and its proof (local lifts of a section of H on a covering, refinement in the cofinal system, the Cech 1-cocycle of differences, correction by a 0-cochain, gluing in G)
